ios.desc:
Keep everyone's score together during board and card games. Track points, check rules for supported games, and pick up an unfinished session later.

COUNT YOUR WAY
Use the universal counter for one or more players. Add or subtract points, undo an entry, and redo it when needed.

CHOOSE A GAME MODE
Dedicated scoring modes and rule references help with supported games. For other games, use the universal counter to keep your own tally.

TOOLS FOR THE TABLE
• Dice and a stopwatch in the universal counter
• Saved sessions to continue later
• An option to keep the screen awake
• Light and dark themes

Board buddy is a free, open-source companion for the physical games you play around a table.

Bring the game. Keep the scores together.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Board Buddy – Open-Source Score for Board Games

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I recently finished and launched a side project I’ve been working on: Board Buddy – a free and open source mobile app that helps track scores and game rules while playing board games with friends.

I built it completely solo — design, development, architecture — and made it open source from the start.

Links:

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/board-buddy-score-counter/id6743980638

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.khlebobul.board_buddy

GitHub: https://github.com/khlebobul/board_buddy

Official site: https://boardbuddyapp.vercel.app

Would love any feedback or thoughts — especially around UX, performance, and features you'd find useful in this kind of app. PRs and stars are very welcome too!

Hey everyone!
I'm excited to share a project I've been working on: Board Buddy(https://boardbuddyapp.vercel.app) — a free cross-platform mobile app for tracking scores and rules in board games. Board Buddy simplifies gameplay by helping you keep track of scores and key points, so you can focus on the game itself and socializing with friends

You can download Board Buddy on the App Store(https://apps.apple.com/app/board-buddy-score-counter/id6743980638) Google Play will be available soon, check out the source code on GitHub(https://github.com/khlebobul/board_buddy), or visit the official website(https://boardbuddyapp.vercel.app/) for more info!

I'd love to hear your feedback, ideas, or even see some PRs if you feel like contributing! If you enjoy the app, leaving a star or a review would absolutely make my day.

Thanks for checking it out!
